title: Baby Totem
description: Upgrade your survival experience by replacing the old, flat vanilla sprite with a sleek, upright 3D Totem of Undying!
body:
Upgrade your survival experience by replacing the old, flat vanilla sprite with a sleek, upright 3D Totem of Undying!

Designed to feel fresh while keeping your UI clean, this pack adds an instant layer of polish to your gameplay without getting in the way of the action. And the best part? It utilizes the newer resource pack formats, meaning no OptiFine or CIT mods are required!

✨ Key Features
Upright 3D Model: Say goodbye to the flat 2D texture. This custom model actually stands upright in your hand and off-hand for a much cooler, realistic aesthetic.

Unobtrusive Screen Space: Tired of giant items blocking your vision? This totem is perfectly scaled to be compact. It stays out of your line of sight, ensuring maximum visibility during intense combat or while recording videos.

Secret "Obio" Skin Variant: Want a completely different look? Take your totem to an Anvil and rename it exactly to Immortal. This will completely change the texture and give you a custom totem featuring Obio's skin!

100% Vanilla Compatible: Built specifically for 1.21.1+, the 3D model and the custom renaming feature work right out of the box in pure vanilla Minecraft.

⚙️ How to Install
Drop the downloaded .zip file into your Minecraft resourcepacks folder.

Go to Options > Resource Packs in-game and enable it.

Ensure it sits at the top of your active list to prevent other packs from overriding the totem.
